data.headline: Walmart adds a consumer reading to the S&P 500 earnings picture
data.summary: Walmart’s third-quarter revenue grew 5.2%, while growth in global online sales reached 17%. The release broadens this week’s issuer evidence beyond technology. The latest E-mini S&P 500 positioning report predates these earnings.

bull.text: Walmart raised its full-year outlook for constant-currency net sales growth to 4.9%–5.2%.

bear.text: Asset managers cut their net long E-mini S&P 500 position from 928,584 contracts on November 3 to 914,130 on November 10.

watch.text: Leveraged funds’ net short fell from 372,318 to 303,060 contracts over the same week. The next CFTC report will show whether the two groups continued to move differently.

limitations: One issuer’s results give limited evidence about the wider index. The CFTC figures describe related futures. Current SPY options exposure and dealer positioning by strike remain unverified.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR · Walmart’s November 19 results filing
